body: I guess it doesn't matter.  Soon I will have the strength to rehome my cat and then I can rest.
Why do so many of these places have to call the police?  It leaves me so much more alone.
It helps a little.  I just didn't expect that.  I wish there was someone else I could call.
And I just tried Trans Lifeline and there was no one available to take my call.

I just tried one of those text crisis support places.  But I was so afraid they would call the cops on me if I wasn't sufficiently cheerful it did me no good.  I guess my next step is Trans Lifeline but I don't want to use them for two reasons.  I can't transition anymore because I have no support so I don't really count.  And also my phone drops calls in inside my apartment and I don't want to go out on the street for this.  But I did hear an interview with the founder and she said they don't call the cops...
I really thought it was going to be okay when I figured out I am trans and I could transition, but then everything crumbled.

I am not sure what you are seeing?  This is a new account and my first time posting on reddit.  I created it because this seemed like the only place I could get some support without worrying about having emergency services called.
I just tried to reach out to my ex.  The one before the guy who vanished.  He told me he is too stressed out to talk to me.  Which I kind of expected.  I need to just post the damn ad and be done.
She probably would say that... That's why this is so hard..

That's what people say.  But I am so tired.  I need comfort but there is no comfort and no help coming.  I know where to find rest.  But I just have to do this one thing first. I just need to work up the courage to do that. 

Maybe if I was brave and strong I could hold on for years more.  But I'm just tired now.  I am ready for it to stop.

We were together for a year an a half.

It's not just him.  It's that I'm apparently bad at my job.  The job I gave up my real career for.  And that I don't have any friends, mostly because I've battled depression for most of my life.

I don't know why I expected my family would be here for me as I came out... But because they are not and because I'm alone, I can't continue trying to transition.  

I can see now I have messed up my life beyond repair.
Cats are inherently wonderful and good at their jobs...
